Public · Ungated · Vendor-neutral

RMM evaluation and operations templates.

Turn requirements, vendor quotes, alert measurements, product pilots, evaluations, patch exceptions, access reviews, client lifecycle work, endpoint changes, migrations, and security incidents into owned, reviewable records. All nineteen templates are plain CSV files—no account, email address, or product installation required.

Machine-readable package: Data tools can consume all nineteen CSV resources, field schemas, byte counts, and SHA-256 hashes through the standards-based Data Package descriptor.
Relationship disclosure: Nizlo, a Windows-first RMM and IT-management platform, maintains these resources. The templates are designed for use with any relevant RMM, inventory, ITAM, service-desk, or CMDB workflow and do not claim that any vendor passes their controls or supports every field.
